title: Fairy Thoughts
intro: Fairy Thoughts are a remake-only collectible: small glowing marks on surfaces around the world. Examine one and Navi reads out a message left by a fairy. Some are hints, some are jokes, and the puzzle ones fully restore your health when you solve them. Grouped by area.
source_note: Written for this app. Locations and requirements follow the Ocarina of Time remake.

entries.title: Hyrule Field - Rock west of Castle Town
entries.steps: On a rock a little west of the Castle Town entrance. Hints that a nearby wooden box holds Rupees.

entries.title: Hyrule Field - Wagon at Kakariko entrance
entries.steps: On a wagon next to the Kakariko Village entrance. Hints that cutting the grass nearby releases Bugs.

entries.title: Hyrule Field - Tree east of Castle Town
entries.steps: On a tree a little east of the Castle Town entrance. Gives the password for the Business Scrub in the nearby grotto. Say it as a child and he sells a Piece of Heart for 100 Rupees.

entries.title: Hyrule Field - Alcove by Zora River
entries.steps: In an alcove on the east edge of Hyrule Field, just south of the Zora River entrance. Hints that Rupees are hidden in the nearby pool of water.

entries.title: Hyrule Field - Far north-west alcove
entries.steps: In a small alcove in the far north-west corner, west of the Castle Town entrance. Tells you Peahats are weak to fire, such as Din's Fire.

entries.title: Hyrule Field - Lon Lon Ranch tower
entries.steps: On the west side of the ruined Lon Lon Ranch tower. Approach from outside the ranch. Play Sun's Song here to be fully healed.

entries.title: Hyrule Field - Ruins near the Kakariko bridge
entries.steps: Written on a ruined wall just east of the Castle Town entrance, close to the bridge toward Kakariko. Its hint: roll into trees to knock things loose.

entries.title: Hyrule Field - Pillar near Lake Hylia
entries.steps: On the back of a crumbling pillar in the far south of the field, close to Lake Hylia. Hold a Deku Stick out near a butterfly and it turns into a Fairy you can use to heal. Try the butterfly nearby.

entries.title: Hyrule Field - Rocks near Gerudo Valley
entries.steps: Under a rocky structure a bit east and north of the Gerudo Valley entrance, next to an empty chest. You must be an adult to see it. The chest is already empty. It is a hint to come back as a child and take the Piece of Heart before someone else does.

entries.title: Hyrule Field - Peahat swamp grotto, part 1
entries.steps: In a grotto in the marshy south-east of the field, among the Peahats. Blow open the entrance with a Bomb, then read the thought on the wall. Kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall of the grotto, then return as an adult for part 2.

entries.title: Hyrule Field - Peahat swamp grotto, part 2
entries.steps: Come back to the same grotto as an adult, after defeating the Skulltula on its wall as a child. The writing has changed: the fairy has trapped a Gold Skulltula. Smash the wooden box beside it to get the token.

entries.title: Lon Lon Ranch - Back of the big barn
entries.steps: On the back of the large barn. A hint to talk to Malon about her song and to play it for the cows.

entries.title: Kakariko Graveyard - Broken pillar by Sun's Song
entries.steps: On a broken pillar near the Sun's Song pedestal. Play Sun's Song here to be fully healed.

entries.title: Kakariko Graveyard - Tomb stairs
entries.steps: On the smashed gravestone behind the stairs down to the royal tomb where you learn Sun's Song. Tells you Sun's Song can stun Redeads, like those in the royal tomb.

entries.title: Death Mountain - Cliff south of Goron City
entries.steps: On a cliff edge slightly south of the Goron City entrance, near the grotto covered by a spinning leaf. Play the Song of Storms to make the leaf lift off and open the grotto below.

entries.title: Zora River - Cliff below the broken bridge
entries.steps: On a cliff face reached by following the river to the broken bridge, jumping over and dropping down. Its hint: bugs let loose over a soft-soil patch draw out a Gold Skulltula. Bugs hide under the rock nearby, and there is a soil patch beside the Magic Bean Seller.

entries.title: Lake Hylia - South-west shore
entries.steps: On the south-west side of the lake, beside an alcove on the narrow strip of land at the edge. A Fairy is hiding in one of the nearby jars. Break it open and catch it in a bottle.

entries.title: Ice Cavern - Compass room
entries.steps: On a wall in the room with the Compass and a Gold Skulltula. Play Sun's Song here to be fully healed.

entries.title: Forest Temple - 3F blue room
entries.steps: On the right side of 3F, in the blue shifting room. You can only read it after shifting the room and opening the gap in the floor. Play Sun's Song here to be fully healed.

entries.title: Fire Temple - Megaton Hammer room
entries.steps: On the south-west wall of the Megaton Hammer room, opposite the chest. Play Sun's Song here to be fully healed.

entries.title: Water Temple - West room of 1F
entries.steps: In the west room of 1F with the descending platforms to the Dark Link fight. Jump to the stray platform on the north wall. Play Sun's Song here to be fully healed.

entries.title: Shadow Temple - B3 spike crusher room
entries.steps: On a cracked wall on B3, in the room with the huge falling spike crushers. Play the Song of Storms here to be fully healed.

entries.title: Spirit Temple - Outside platform
entries.steps: Outside the temple, on the platform between the chests holding the Silver Gauntlets and the Mirror Shield. Reachable as a child or an adult. Play the Song of Storms here to be fully healed.
